label: Finite graph
definition: A finite set of vertices together with edges joining specified vertex pairs or ordered pairs.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

includes: simple, directed, weighted, and multi-edge variants when declared

label: Graph incidence and adjacency
definition: Relations expressing which vertices and edges meet and which vertices are joined.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Graph walk, path, and cycle
definition: Successive incidence structures used to describe movement or connection through a graph.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Graph connectivity
definition: The structural property that specified vertices can be linked by paths, globally or within components.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Weighted and directed graph
definition: A graph whose edges carry direction, weight, capacity, cost, or another declared attribute.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Finite-graph degree-sum relation
definition: In a finite undirected graph, summing vertex degrees counts each edge endpoint and therefore counts each edge twice.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Node-link diagram
definition: A spatial depiction of vertices as marks and edges as links, with layout normally separate from graph identity.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Graph adjacency representation
definition: An adjacency list, matrix, edge list, or equivalent finite encoding of graph incidence.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Interpret and construct finite graphs
definition: Within Graphs and Networks, this family groups bounded performances under the shared purpose "Interpret and construct finite graphs": Construct a finite graph model; Interpret a finite-graph representation.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Analyze paths and connectivity
definition: Within Graphs and Networks, this family groups bounded performances under the shared purpose "Analyze paths and connectivity": Analyze finite-graph connectivity; Construct a constrained graph walk; Determine local graph structure.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Solve bounded network-structure problems
definition: Within Graphs and Networks, this family groups bounded performances under the shared purpose "Solve bounded network-structure problems": Construct a finite spanning tree; Solve a finite shortest-path problem.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Interpret a finite-graph representation
definition: Recover graph objects, relations, and declared attributes from a finite diagram or adjacency representation.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given a finite node-link diagram, edge list, adjacency list, or matrix with stated conventions, identify vertices, edges, adjacency, incidence, direction, weights, and representation-dependent features accurately.

label: Construct a finite graph model
definition: Represent a bounded relational situation as a finite graph while distinguishing modeling choices from facts in the situation.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given a bounded situation involving pairwise or directed relations, define vertices and edges, select relevant attributes, construct a finite graph representation, and explain what the model includes and omits.

label: Determine local graph structure
definition: Determine adjacency, incidence, neighborhoods, and degrees for a finite graph under stated graph conventions.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given a finite graph and stated conventions, determine requested adjacencies, incidences, neighborhoods, vertex degrees, and degree totals, and check them against the degree-sum relation when applicable.

label: Analyze finite-graph connectivity
definition: Determine reachability, connected components, or disconnection evidence in a finite graph.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given a finite graph and specified vertices or subsets, determine reachability and connected components by exhibiting paths or a valid separation argument under the declared directed or undirected interpretation.

label: Construct a constrained graph walk
definition: Construct or rule out a walk, path, trail, or cycle meeting explicit finite constraints.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given a finite graph and explicit endpoint, repetition, length, or coverage constraints, construct a qualifying walk, path, trail, or cycle, or justify why none exists for the scoped case.

label: Solve a finite shortest-path problem
definition: Find and justify a minimum-weight path in a finite graph with conditions suited to the selected method.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given a finite weighted graph, specified endpoints, and weights satisfying the chosen method's conditions, determine a shortest path, report its weight, and provide enough intermediate evidence to check optimality.

label: Construct a finite spanning tree
definition: Construct and verify a tree that contains every vertex of a connected finite graph, optionally under a stated weight objective.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate decomposition; requires accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given a connected finite graph, construct a spanning tree and verify vertex coverage, connectedness, and absence of cycles; when minimizing weight, justify the selected edges under a valid method.
